fields.FIR_Description: It was alleged that an investment offer shared in a messaging group led the complainant to deposit Rs. 2,40,000, after which contact ended. The matter was brought to Erode North PS on 2026-03-26, while the incident was placed on 2026-03-24 at about 09:15. Venkat Kumar submitted the complaint online using the mobile number 9000000274. Madhan Babu (mobile 9000000490) was named as a possible person of interest. Ramesh Pandian (9000000469) noticed the incident and may be able to provide a statement. The account reference SYN-ACC-100041 was noted in connection with the payment. Udhay Muthu (9000000352), described as an intermediary, was also mentioned in the complaint. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00213, as the mobile number 9000000490 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Scheme reportedly promoted through a messaging group.
fields.Keywords: investment fraud, high returns, associate, bank reference, main street, witness, suspect, mobile number
